provenance.source: Notification shapes follow `codex app-server generate-json-schema` from the installed codex-cli 0.169.0 (ThreadItem commandExecution with CommandExecutionStatus, item/started startedAtMs, item/completed completedAtMs, turn/completed). The lifecycle of a backgrounded command (item still open at turn/completed, item/completed after it) was observed in a codex-cli 0.169.0 rollout. Thread ids, commands and paths are synthetic; no credentials or user content.
provenance.expected_by: Hand-written from the provider contract and the background-work contract in vertebrae-harness-core, not generated by the adapter.
